hero.subtitle: Let's think it through together.
hero.intro: Why a website? Why us? And what happens if you skip it? Scroll down — we'll answer the questions every business owner asks, then help you pick a plan.
hero.imageAlt: Jolly Panda mascot thinking about an idea that turns into a website

q1.title: Why does my business need a website?
q1.subtitle: Because that's where people look first — and where you get to tell your own story.

i1.title: Open 24/7
i1.desc: Your website answers questions, shows your work and collects inquiries while you sleep.

i2.title: People search before they call
i2.desc: Customers look you up online first. A website is what they find.

i3.title: It builds trust
i3.desc: Your own address and a clean design tell visitors you're a real, established business.

i4.title: You own it
i4.desc: Social pages can change their rules or reach overnight. Your website stays yours.

i5.title: It brings new customers
i5.desc: Be found on search engines by people who are already looking for what you offer.

i6.title: You can measure it
i6.desc: See who visits, what they read and where they get stuck — then improve.

q2.title: What happens if I don't have one?
q2.subtitle: Nothing dramatic — you just quietly lose opportunities every day.

without.title: Without a website
without.i1: Customers who search for you find nothing — or find your competitor.
without.i2: You look less established than the businesses that do have one.
without.i3: You depend on platforms whose rules and reach can change anytime.
without.i4: Every price, address and question has to be answered by hand.
without.i5: You can't tell what's working, so you can't improve it.

with.title: With a website
with.i1: People find you on search engines, at any hour of the day.
with.i2: You look professional from the very first click.
with.i3: You own your audience and your story.
with.i4: Answers, prices and contact details are always one click away.
with.i5: You see real numbers and make better decisions.

q3.title: Why build it with Jolly Panda?
q3.subtitle: Six things you get when you work with us.

i1.title: Design and code, one team
i1.desc: The people who design your site are the people who build it — no hand-offs, no lost details.

i2.title: Clear prices from the start
i2.desc: Starting prices for every plan are published in US dollars. The final price is set together in a consultation.

i3.title: Mobile-ready and secure
i3.desc: Every plan includes responsive design for phones and tablets, plus an SSL certificate.

i4.title: Support after launch
i4.desc: From 1 month of support on Economy to 6 months of priority support on Custom.

i5.title: Persian and English, RTL and LTR
i5.desc: We build bilingual, right-to-left-ready sites every day — this very website is one.

i6.title: Built for speed and search
i6.desc: Light, fast pages with clean structure, so visitors stay and search engines understand you.

q4.title: How is a website made?
q4.intro: No jargon, no mystery. Four steps from a first chat to a live website.
q4.imageAlt: Jolly Panda mascot showing a website on a laptop, tablet and phone

s1.title: Consultation
s1.desc: You tell us about your business and goals. Together we settle on the plan and the final price.

s2.title: Design
s2.desc: A customized template or a fully custom interface — depending on your plan.

s3.title: Build
s3.desc: We build the pages and features, optimize speed and SEO, and test on phone, tablet and desktop.

s4.title: Launch & support
s4.desc: Your site goes live, and we stay available for the support period included in your plan.

q4.included: Every plan includes responsive design (mobile and tablet) and an SSL certificate.
q4.separate: Domain and hosting costs are charged separately from the plans.
